name: Fujikawa Kazuaki
source:
A classical Japanese literature teacher working at the same academy as Sayaka.

He has a gentle personality and never gets angry at his students, which sometimes leads them to take advantage of him or look down on him a little.

He and Sayaka work together as homeroom teacher and assistant homeroom teacher. They occasionally discuss problems, with him offering her advice, and sometimes go out drinking together.

He is divorced. His former wife eventually became fed up with him and left, an experience that he still hasn't entirely gotten over.

Initially, he sincerely listens to Sayaka's problems and offers her support. However, gradually...

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11291]the official site[/url]]
